title: Bias Out-of-the-Box: An Empirical Analysis of Intersectional Occupational Biases in Popular Generative Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and benchmarks the models' occupational biases across the protected category of religion. It analyzes five religious traditions (Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, and Muslim) and provides specific data and discussion regarding the model's associations with religious roles like monks, nuns, rabbis, and priests.
